question:
Select the correct mirror image of the given combination when the mirror is placed at MN as shown below

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13f934ee5873fc5f052487af4c91b892ae140d89a1e684f3251064b3ec3422cb.png]
solution:
Here, we are given the word and we need to find the mirror image of it.

First keep in mind that, in mirror image the first letter will be the last letter of the given word. Also, the size of the letters will not change i.e. capital letters will appear capital only.

Next, as we can see the given word ends with r, so the mirror image will have r as the first letter. 

Again, letter e is water image in option 2 and 3, so both the options are eliminated.

Again, letter r is water image in option 4, so option 4 is eliminated.

Thus, we have only one option left i.e. option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5cdbbf9f3588ddcf9246daf778f2e8c8299490a3cdcd3bf558d9bb28ebfdd909.png] 

Hence, the mirror image of the given word is '**__option 1__**'. 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] __Confusion Points__** Keep in mind what is the difference between mirror image and water image.
